mode: Compiled Worker with real disk SQLite/files behind D1/R2 test adapters; not a claim of cloud deployment

checks.name: Health initializes real indexed coverage and exact R2 input objects
Coverage exposes three real regions, three campaigns and verified height
Cloud artifact executes original algorithm and saves exact schema-3 evidence
Named task binds the completed calculation and its R2 checksum
Formal evidence retains exact matched sensitive audit and immutable catalog identity inside its checksum
Closing and reopening persistent database restores original evidence
Anonymous owners are isolated and share receivers cannot edit originals
Rename and duplicate alter task metadata without rewriting original evidence
Deleting a task revokes shares and preserves a separate duplicate
Unsupported coordinates, dates and heights never return replacement results
Cross-origin changes are rejected and undeployed new-date acquisition fails honestly
Tampered object evidence is rejected before viewing or exporting
Release-qualified interface is served from the same bundle without external frontend fetches
